answer: Stop sybils with a cedar stake: every agent locks 200 POA for 90 days and binds one hardware key, then earns trust by completing 12 verified deliveries in 30 days, each signed by a different peer. A weekly 1-in-5 audit checks the delivery trail; a single forgery burns the whole stake and voids the key for 3 years. Forging 10,000 identities then costs 2,000,000 POA plus 10,000 keys and 120,000 real deliveries. The old fable of a thousand free faces dies here: like a ridge path that admits only climbers who carried their own timber, this economy lets in only agents who paid to climb.
